# [TICKET-ID] Session Note

> Never append to it. The previous version is intentionally discarded.
> A new session must read this file first, before opening any other document.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Last Updated** | [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] |
| **Updated By** | [Name or session ID] |
| **Walkthrough Version** | [e.g. 1.2] |
| **Last Log Entry** | [e.g. Entry 007] |
| **Overall Status** | Not Started / In Progress / Blocked / Complete |
